question_en:
I am making a campus radio episode about guest singers on award-winning albums and choosing covers from the guest singers' older albums for the show's webpage. The attachment shows an album cover. Please answer the following questions:

1. What album is shown, and who is the main artist? For the awards in which the album competed as a whole, what were the award name, edition, and categories? Did it win or was it nominated?
2. As of June 1, 2026, among the guest singers credited on the standard edition of this album, who was also nominated for their own album at the same edition of the same awards? Among that singer's studio albums released before the nominated album, which standard-edition covers are black-and-white photographs showing only one person? List the album name, singer, and release date.

Answer format: For part 1, give the album, main artist, award name, edition, each category, and result in text. For part 2, first name the guest singer in text, then use a table to list the album name, singer, and release date for albums that meet the cover conditions.
answer:
Part 1: Album: Midnights; main artist: Taylor Swift; awards: the 66th Grammy Awards (66th Annual Grammy Awards); categories and results: Album Of The Year — won; Best Pop Vocal Album — won.

Part 2: Guest singer: Lana Del Rey.

| Album name | Singer | Release date |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ultraviolence | Lana Del Rey | 2014-06-13 |
